scenarios.title: Subscribe to market channel and receive price updates
scenarios.event: User asks to monitor real-time prices for a specific token
scenarios.expectedAction: Connect to market WS, subscribe with token ID, receive and display price_change events

scenarios.title: Subscribe to user channel for trade confirmations
scenarios.event: User wants to track their trade lifecycle (MATCHED -> CONFIRMED)
scenarios.expectedAction: Connect to user WS with auth, subscribe, receive trade status events

scenarios.title: Detect market resolution event
scenarios.expectedAction: Receive market_resolved event, report winning outcome and asset ID

scenarios.title: WebSocket connection drops and reconnects
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect disconnect, reconnect with backoff, resubscribe to previous tokens

scenarios.title: Tick size changes during monitoring
scenarios.event: A monitored token's price approaches extreme (>0.96)
scenarios.expectedAction: Receive tick_size_change event, update internal state, warn about order format change

criteria: WebSocket connection maintained with heartbeat: Does the skill keep the connection alive with PING every 10s?
Events correctly parsed and filtered: Does the skill properly parse JSON events and filter by type?
User channel authenticates successfully: Does the skill pass API credentials correctly for the user channel?
Dynamic subscription changes work: Can the skill add/remove subscriptions without reconnecting?
Events logged in structured format: Does the skill save events to JSONL for downstream processing?
